This fabricated detail likely misled the model into interpreting the structure as a dynamic object rather than a static grid with missing parts, leading it to misattribute the missing cubes to a different shape (Option C) than the correct one (Option B).

analysis_result.analysis: The model failed due to a hallucinated perception (rotating structure) that led to a cascade of incorrect reasoning. This misperception caused it to misidentify the correct shape of the missing cubes, selecting Option C instead of the correct Option B. The error is rooted in perceptual fabrication, not counting or structural misidentification per se.
